name: 바이낸스 탈취 사건(2026)

c_id.basis: 식별 시점(2026-11-12) 기준 등급. 2026-10-31 FBI 경보가 수행 주체를 단정 서술 — 「The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is releasing information advising the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, on or about October 29, 2026.」(tech_04_FBI_20261031.txt:8) · 「The FBI refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as "TraderTraitor."」(tech_04_FBI_20261031.txt:8). 2026-11-12 미 법무부 보도자료도 단정 서술 — 「members of the North Korean military, referred to by the FBI as “TraderTraitor” stole more than $6 billion worth of virtual assets from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:30). 그 전의 보안업체 서술: 2026-10-29 TRM Labs 「TRM attributes the attack to TraderTraitor, North Korea’s elite hacking unit, based on robust on and off-chain intelligence. We make this judgment with high confidence.」(tech_05_TRMLabs_20261029.txt:14), 2026-10-30 Chainalysis 「Chainalysis attributes the hack to TraderTraitor, a North Korean cybercrime group.」(tech_08_Chainalysis_20261030.txt:20), Elliptic은 FBI 발표 전 「Elliptic had assessed TraderTraitor as the likely perpetrator before the announcement.」(tech_07_Elliptic_20261030.txt:24). 반대 방향 서술: 2026-10-30 Cointegrity 「TraderTraitor is the probable perpetrator, on circumstantial evidence.」(tech_10_Cointegrity_20261030.txt:40), 북한의 부인 「Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, rejected the FBI’s attribution in a statement carried by KCNA」(tech_17_Rekt_20261106.txt:425). 식별 시점 이후의 상승은 묶음에 없음(자료 기준일 2026-11-12).

c_st.basis: 식별 시점(2026-11-12) 기준 등급. 2026-11-12 미 법무부 보도자료가 수행자를 국가기관(군) 소속으로 특정 — 「members of the North Korean military, referred to by the FBI as “TraderTraitor” stole more than $6 billion worth of virtual assets from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:30), 같은 문서 「Today the Department of Justice announced coordinated actions against the Democratic People’s Republic of North Korea (DPRK) government’s schemes to fund its regime through the massive theft of cryptocurrency.」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:15). 첫 공식 귀속 성명일 2026-10-31 — FBI 경보 「The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is releasing information advising the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, on or about October 29, 2026.」(tech_04_FBI_20261031.txt:8); 그 성명의 날짜는 「On October 31, 2026, the FBI, the U.S. Secret Service and IRS Criminal Investigation attributed the theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor.」(tech_13_ReversingLabs_20261031.txt:110)로 확인(FBI 문서 본문에는 게시일 표기가 없음). 첫 성명(2026-10-31)은 국가를 책임 주체로 단정하되 소속 기관은 특정하지 않음. reference_date에는 등급 5의 근거(기관 소속 특정)인 미 법무부 성명의 날짜를 적음.

access_depth.basis: 한 침투 안의 최댓값(관측 서술만). 2026-09 엔지니어 B의 업무용 컴퓨터 감염 「Engineer B was instructed to download an “assignment” containing a malicious code repository onto his work computer.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:63) → 2026-10-20 내부 AI 도구로 지갑 담당 엔지니어 A·C의 단말 장악 「The attacker leveraged the compromised computer of engineer B and used an internal AI tool to gain control over the Wallet DevOps Engineer A and another Wallet Software Engineer C.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:81) → 2026-10-29 탈취한 자격증명으로 컨테이너 배포 「On 29 October between 17:15 and 19:56, the attacker logged onto Software Engineer C’s computer, used the credentials stolen from Wallet DevOps Engineer A, deployed a container, and triggered a malicious script to launch the attack.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:83) → 내부 지갑 서명 서비스에 무단 접근해 정상 출금 절차 밖의 거래 개시 「The attacker exploited unauthorized access to an internal wallet signing service to initiate transactions outside the normal withdrawal process.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:27). 지갑 서명 서비스를 핵심 업무망의 특권 자산으로 보아 core. OT/ICS 구절은 묶음에 없음.

effect_realized.note: 유형 ②(조작·공개): 지시문 §3-3에 따라 자산 탈취를 이 칸에서 판정 — 2026-10-29 20:05~23:56 UTC 핫월렛 자산이 공격자 주소로 이전 「Between 20:05 UTC and 20:09 UTC, five Binance hot wallets sent 233.46 million XRP to an attacker-controlled address.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:29) · 「The final unauthorized transfer of 2,961.9 ETH finalised on-chain at 23:56 UTC.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:47), 피해 규모 「Approximately USD 6.34 billion in digital assets were impacted by the incident.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:13) → post. 유형 ①(절취): 자산 탈취는 근거로 쓰지 않음. 탈취된 자격증명의 사용 「used the credentials stolen from Wallet DevOps Engineer A」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:83)과 엔지니어 역할·동료 정보 노출 「However, Engineer A’s role and his related colleagues on our wallet infrastructure team was exposed to the hacker.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:55)을 정보 절취로 보아 post — 수단 단계의 절취라 판정이 갈릴 수 있음. 유형 ③(파괴·교란): 공격자가 피해 시스템을 파괴·교란했다는 구절은 없고 출금 중단은 바이낸스의 차단 조치로 서술됨 「Binance immediately initiated multiple containment measures, including suspending withdrawals to restrict further outflows」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:39) → pre. 다만 바이낸스가 이용자에게 끼친 disruption을 언급하고 「This should not have happened, and we apologise for the concern, disruption and uncertainty it caused our users, partners and the wider industry.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:9) 출금 재개가 2026-11-01이어서 「November 1, 06:00 UTC: Binance announced it has begun reopening withdrawals, starting with $BTC Bitcoin network.」(tech_07_Elliptic_20261030.txt:14) ③ 판정을 경계 사례로 표시(boundary_flag=true). 종합값은 ②가 post이므로 post.

intrusion_state.basis: 식별 시점(2026-11-12) 기준. 2026-10-29 23:56 UTC 마지막 무단 이체 뒤 추가 무단 이체 없음 「No further unauthorised transfers were observed after.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:47), 2026-10-30 00:10 UTC EIP-7702 위임 해제 「At 00:10 UTC on 30 October 2026, Binance executed a new authorization from the Binance14 hot wallet to the zero address, clearing the EIP-7702 delegation code.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:49), 2026-11-03 보고 기준 진입 지점 폐쇄·공격 경로 시스템 재구축 「The entry points identified as having been used in the attack have been closed. Systems touched in the attack path have been rebuilt or replaced.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:15), 관련 자격증명·토큰 폐기 「Decommissioned credentials and tokens related to affected engineers.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:95). 피해 기업의 자체 발표이고 조사는 진행 중 「The investigation remains ongoing and our findings will be subject to further independent review.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:17) — 독립 검토 결과는 묶음에 없음.

legal_characterization.quote: The FBI refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as "TraderTraitor."
북한의 불법 사이버 활동은 북한 핵·미사일 프로그램의 주요 자금원일 뿐 아니라 글로벌 디지털 경제에 대한 위협입니다.
North Korea’s government bankrolls its rogue regime and illicit weapons program through cryptocurrency theft
we worked together to freeze this massive criminal fraud in its tracks

effect_at_response.basis: 대응 개시 시점(2026-10-31)에 탈취 효과가 이미 발현 — 「The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is releasing information advising the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, on or about October 29, 2026.」(tech_04_FBI_20261031.txt:8). 성명일은 「On October 31, 2026, the FBI, the U.S. Secret Service and IRS Criminal Investigation attributed the theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor.」(tech_13_ReversingLabs_20261031.txt:110).

대응 개시 시점(2026-11-12)에 탈취 효과가 이미 발현 — 「members of the North Korean military, referred to by the FBI as “TraderTraitor” stole more than $6 billion worth of virtual assets from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:30).

대응 개시 시점(2026-11-12)에 탈취 효과가 이미 발현 — 탈취 자산에 대한 법원 허가 압수·보전 「the court-authorized seizure and restraint of more than $1.2 billion worth of cryptocurrency recently stolen from Binance, a virtual currency exchange」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:15) · 「Collective U.S. government and private sector efforts so far have resulted in the freeze of more than $2.7 billion, with the Department having already obtained court-authorization to seize or restrain in excess of $1.2 billion of that amount.」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:30) · 「Efforts to trace, freeze, seize, and forfeit the stolen virtual assets are ongoing」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:31).

notes: [금전 동기] 묶음은 탈취 목적을 정권 자금 조달로 서술 — 「This group has repeatedly targeted the cryptocurrency industry, exchanges, DeFi protocols, and investors to raise funds for the regime.」(tech_08_Chainalysis_20261030.txt:30) · 미 법무부 「North Korea’s government bankrolls its rogue regime and illicit weapons program through cryptocurrency theft」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:16). 판정에 쓰지 않고 여기에만 둠. [행위자 표기] actor는 FBI 표기 그대로. ReversingLabs는 다른 이름과 상위 묶음을 함께 서술 — 「TraderTraitor, also tracked as Jade Sleet, UNC4899, Slow Pisces and Pressure Chollima, is a financially motivated North Korean cluster within the Lazarus umbrella.」(tech_13_ReversingLabs_20261031.txt:142) — Lazarus는 상위 묶음이라 alias에 넣지 않음. SafeDep의 Contagious Interview 평가는 별도 군집 서술이 있어 alias에 넣지 않음 — 「most vendors track Contagious Interview as a separate North Korean cluster」(tech_13_ReversingLabs_20261031.txt:142). 미 법무부 보도자료의 FaceStealer 부분은 이 사건과 별개로 서술되어 행위자·대응에서 뺌 — 「Separately from the FaceStealer campaign」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:30). [귀속에 대한 반응] 북한은 부인 — 「North Korea has denied involvement.」(tech_13_ReversingLabs_20261031.txt:110) · 「Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, rejected the FBI’s attribution in a statement carried by KCNA」(tech_17_Rekt_20261106.txt:425). [대한민국] 외교부 대변인은 2026-11-05·2026-11-10 정례브리핑에서 독자 제재 등 추가 방안을 검토 중이라고 답함 — 「사이버 독자 제재를 포함해서 추가적인 방안에 대해서 내부 검토 중이지만 아직 확정되지는 않았음」(resp_17_외교부_20261105.txt:28) · 「방금 말씀드린 사항은 계속 내부적으로 검토 중이고 확정된 바는 아직 없음」(resp_18_외교부_20261110.txt:19) — 이 사건을 북한에 귀속하는 명시 문장이 없고 실행된 조치가 아니어서 responses와 c_st 근거에 넣지 않음. [보안업체 규정] 업체들은 탈취·범죄로 서술(예: 「the largest crypto theft on record」(tech_06_Blockaid_20261029.txt:12)) — legal_characterization에 올리지 않음. [미국 관점] victim_state는 템플릿값 그대로. 묶음에는 미국 정부의 귀속·압수 조치 구절은 있으나 미국을 피해국으로 서술하는 구절은 없음. [묶음 간 수치 차이] 피해액은 약 63억~64.3억 달러, 동결액은 약 27억~30억 달러, 피해 체인 수는 10~11로 문서마다 다름.
collection_mode_basis: 저자가 사례로 선정(2026-11-13), 표적 수집 아님
target_specificity_basis: 특정 기관(바이낸스)의 지갑 인프라 담당자를 겨냥한 침투 — 2026-06 지갑 DevOps 엔지니어 A의 역할·동료 노출 「However, Engineer A’s role and his related colleagues on our wallet infrastructure team was exposed to the hacker.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:55), 2026-09 바이낸스 경력을 프로필에 적은 엔지니어 B에게 접근 「Software Engineer B had a profile on the platform that referenced his experience at Binance.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:59), 2026-10-29 바이낸스 핫월렛에서 탈취 「Between 20:05 UTC and 20:09 UTC, five Binance hot wallets sent 233.46 million XRP to an attacker-controlled address.」(tech_01_Binance_20261103.txt:29).
victim_sector_sub_note: 주 표적(방어국 = 미국 · 지시문 §3-4): 묶음이 서술하는 주된 피해 기관은 암호자산 거래소 바이낸스 하나 — 「cryptocurrency exchange Binance」(tech_04_FBI_20261031.txt:8) · 「Binance, a virtual currency exchange」(resp_16_DOJ_20261112.txt:15) → financial_services(상위 finance_commerce). 묶음에 바이낸스의 소재국이나 미국 소재 피해 기관을 특정하는 구절은 없음. 2차 영향을 받은 곳(대출 프로토콜·스테이블코인 발행사 등)은 피해 기관으로 넣지 않음.

victim_assets.quote: Our initial investigation suggests this security incident may have started with a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop.
